Record Class WatchlistTreemapBuilder.Input

java.lang.Object
java.lang.Record
grafioschtrader.reports.WatchlistTreemapBuilder.Input
Record Components:
stocks - the active direct stocks of the watchlist, with current price and change
shares - selected share count per security
marketCaps - market capitalisation stated by the data source per security
ratesToMain - rate into the main currency per foreign currency; a currency without rate is absent
closes - close of the newest opened session as UTC time per security; absent when unknown
mainCurrency - main currency of the tenant
language - language of the labels of the groups
notApplicableCount - instruments of the watchlist that are no active direct stocks
now - the current time in UTC
Enclosing class:
WatchlistTreemapBuilder

Everything the market map is calculated from.

      public final boolean equals(Object o)
      Indicates whether some other object is "equal to" this one. The objects are equal if the other object is of the same class and if all the record components are equal. Reference components are compared with Objects::equals(Object,Object); primitive components are compared with the compare method from their corresponding wrapper classes.
